quests.title: Forbidding Doors of Melancholy

dialogue.t: The bridge to the assembly hall is right over there. But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here...
Hmm... Is this "Furiosa" someone really important, Nastya? Paimon's heard you mention her quite a few times now.
Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are at number two for now.
You should have a match-up with her when you have the time! Maybe the rankings will change then!

dialogue.sit: A chance to shake up the leaderboard has appeared!
But if I can't beat her, can I concede the match instead?

dialogue.t: Aw, yeah! {NICKNAME} is a super good fighter, you know!
But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!
No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Zhara, the Doctor, and the two of you too!
It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!
...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, she got new, stronger arms, and she became even better at fighting.
After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...
She's gone... We can enter the assembly hall now!
Nastya? What is it? We're almost at your home, aren't we...?
I just don't understand... Why did Furiosa try to stop me... and why hasn't she turned into the Perfect Tree yet?
It's not opening from this side... or from this side either...
Paimonka, Big Brother(Big Sister) {NICKNAME}, we usually go through this door in the middle, but I think it's now locked from the inside...

dialogue.sit: Looks like we can get in through here.

dialogue.t: Hmm, I think... I can squeeze in through here? Wait for me. I'll go open the door.
Okay! Just call out to us if you run into any trouble, Nastya. Paimon can squeeze through to help too!

dialogue.sit: Nastya deftly slipped through the gap...

dialogue.t: Wow... This place is... spectacular...
Yeah, it's super pretty, huh? Gets boring if you stay here too long, though.
We used to sit here, carrying the booklets Dr. Moreau wrote us and reciting the prayers he wrote for Zhara. I only remember a few lines...
"Once, I was a firebird, burning on a rusty roof..."
"It pecks at wheat-grains of flesh, and drinks the bitter wine of thought..."
"...Until it becomes a silent tree, growing new branches and leaves in the warm ashes."
Reciting prayers is no fun. I would space out a lot of the time, so I remember most of the places here...
Huh? Why is the curtain drawn here? There should be a road behind it that leads home.
Let me see... There's a mechanism that can open the curtain over there... Ugh, it's so high up. I can't reach it.

dialogue.sit: You can wait for us here, Nastya.

dialogue.t: That's right. We'll meet up with you once we've activated the mechanism.
...But I don't wanna wait here by myself. You're not family, but I don't want us to split up.
Please let me come along... Don't worry, I'll stick real close, just like Paimonka...
O—Okay then. Then let's go together... Who knows, maybe you'll be able to help us out somehow, eh, Nastya?
Can we go up there and activate the switch together now?

dialogue.sit: Let me think of a way first.
I know what to do.

dialogue.t: Okay... Good luck!

dialogue.sit: The curtains don't budge an inch...

dialogue.t: Huh? Why isn't anything happening? Is the switch broken because it hasn't been used in really long or something?
Hmm, I think there's another switch on the other side. The curtain should open if we use both switches at the same time.
Tell you what, Paimon's gonna fly over there, and you two stay here and activate this switch...

dialogue.sit: You might not have enough strength to do that, Paimon.
Maybe I should go to the other side instead.

dialogue.t: Hey! Paimon's stronger than you think, okay! It's just a tiny switch... Mmgh... Ugh... The switch must be jammed!
I'll give Paimonka a hand. The two of us together should be as good as one Big Brother(Big Sister) {NICKNAME}.
Can we do it...? Hold on... Let's do it together... One, two, three!
Yes!!! We did it! Nastya and Paimon will stay on this side. You go over to the other side, and when Paimon gives the signal, we'll activate the mechanisms at the same time...

dialogue.sit: Aye, aye. Ready for your orders, Captain!

dialogue.t: Let's see... We should be able to get through from over there.
Be careful now, Big Brother(Big Sister) {NICKNAME}! That way looks dangerous! You haven't grown any branches yet, so it'll really hurt if you fall!
What is it, Big Brother(Big Sister) {NICKNAME}? Is something wrong?

dialogue.sit: ...I'm a little worried about you and Paimon.
It's nothing.

dialogue.t: No need to worry. I'll protect Paimonka, and Paimonka will protect me.
A little tree will be blown over by the wind, but two little trees can lean on each other.
Huh? Is {NICKNAME} already on the other side???
Then Paimon must yell really, really loudly so that he(she) can hear Paimon clearly!
Alright, think that does it! Ooh, there's an elevator here. Let's meet up with {NICKNAME} downstairs.
Hey, {NICKNAME}! We'll see you downstairs!
I remember this was carved to look like Zhara. But Zhara doesn't look like this anymore.
We have to keep going, through here...
Oh, okay! Onward we go~ Hang on, isn't this just a wall?
This is the doorway to home. Only the ones who are chosen can go through and become eternal life free of all worries.
Doctor Moreau is the only one who's supposed to know how to open this door, but... But one time, I saw how he did it when I was hiding in a corner of the hall...

dialogue.sit: Nastya draws a simple diagram and hands it to you.

dialogue.t: Hmm, so this thing is actually a dial. To open the door behind it, we have to turn it to match the right pattern...
Hmm... Once we go through the doorway, we're at home. But...

dialogue.sit: What's on your mind, Nastya?
Don’t worry. I'll open the doorway.

dialogue.t: N-Nothing. I don't know why, but my heart feels a little messy, like a pile of fallen leaves...
The doctor once said that "the closer you get to home, the more nervous you feel.” I never understood it back then, but now I think I get it...
The dial isn't doing anything... Uh, is the mechanism here broken?
...Oh! I remember now! For the last step, we gotta put the "salt" there.
Doctor Moreau said that for a person to turn into the Perfect Tree, they have to change in three ways...
"Cast off the soul of the past, and it shall no longer be bound by the hidden veins of the earth." Then, the thing that replaces the soul of the past is... the um... s—sulfur of the soul?
"Cast off the will of the past, and it shall no longer be watched by the gaze above." And the thing that replaces the will is the silver of the spirit.

The last thing you have to cast off is... "Cast off the body of the past, and it shall no longer be worn away by the toil and turmoil of the mortal world." So at this point, we have to offer up the material that will replace the body.
So uh... The salt is... the new body that grows from the old one. Yes, that's it!
Ow... This hurts a little more than I thought.
Nastya... Are you okay?
I'm okay. It hurts a lot, but I'm happy. This way, I can go back home, and you can find the Doctor and ask him about Koshchei.
So this little bit of hurt doesn't matter... Hurry, hurry up and offer up the salt.
...Uh, okay, sure. We'll do as you say. {NICKNAME}, let's put this little branch on that platform.
Oh yeah... the day the Volkodlak took us away, all of us kids were told to go to the assembly hall. My... My friends were probably here too...
It's been so long since I saw them.
Uhh... Have you found anything?

dialogue.sit: Not yet.
We've found something...

dialogue.t: Same here. Then we must hurry.

dialogue.sit: After finding a suitable spot, Nastya tosses over the items she just found to you...

dialogue.t: Phew... I'm just glad everyone's okay! I didn't know we were gonna find so many people here... behind the shelves.
Same... One second it was dead quiet, and the next, BOOM! They just came rushing out like that!
But hey, look at that new path that just opened up over here.

dialogue.sit: It looks like the way home to me.

dialogue.t: I don't know about that. But looks like it's the only path now, and the Doctor said before, "The only path is the right path."
So as long as I follow this path, I'm sure I'll make it back to mama and turn into the Perfect Tree...
The Doctor should be home too. He's never gonna leave. Zhara is protecting him, so I know he's there.

dialogue.sit: Looks like we're close to finding the answer...

dialogue.t: Let's keep going, then... Once we get to your "home" and meet Koshchei... no, Paimon means that "Doctor Moreau," we should finally get the answers we've been looking for.

dialogue.sit: (test)火鸟站在屋顶俯视，逆光下展示剪影，然后飞往树湖

dialogue.t: But where is Furiosa? I usually see her around here... I really wanna to see her!
Hmm... Is Furiosa very important to you, Nastya?
Of course! She's my idol! Or should I say, she's still my number-one idol right now, and you two are now at number two.
But that ranking's just for now. If you ever get a chance to spar someday, maybe that ranking will change!

dialogue.sit: A chance to shake up the leaderboard has appeared!
But if I can't beat her, can I concede the match instead?

dialogue.t: That's right, that's right! {NICKNAME} is a super good fighter, you know!
But Paimon gets it now: Nastya likes people who are good at fighting. The stronger, the better!
No, no, Paimonka, you got it all wrong. I like people who can protect others. That's why I like Furiosa, Zhara, the Doctor, and the two of you too!
It's just that the stronger you are, the more people you can protect... I think that's why Furiosa said yes to growing branches!
...They say she was the first person in town to grow branches. After the Doctor helped her grow them, all the problems she had went away... And she became even better at fighting.
After that, everyone started spending most of their time at the assembly hall, while she stayed outside to keep us safe...
So you want to keep more people safe too, Nastya? Is that why you want to grow leaves and branches too?
Um... I never really thought about it like that... I mean, I'm so small. Even if I got stronger, I still won't be that strong. All I want is to be just like everyone else in the family...
Hmm, if we do see Furiosa later, I wonder if she'll still know who I am...
Oh, she definitely will! ...Hold on, what if she's like Zhara!? What if she thinks we're Badbugs, stomps all over us, and burns us to a crisp!?
Mmm, don't worry about that. Furiosa will still spar with you even if you aren't Badbugs.
And burning Badbugs isn't her job... So even if she really thinks you two are Badbugs, you should be fine.
That'd better be the case!

quests.description: You’ve taken the elevator up. Now, the assembly hall is right in front of you…
